notes: Corrected the placement of 'but'. The accepted alignment gave it to the article of the adverbial τὰ νῦν, but an article contributes no part of such a fused adverbial expression (rule 93's principle), and 'now' answers wholly to νῦν. The verse is rule 88's shape — a circumstantial participle (ὑπεριδών) converted into a coordinate finite clause with the juncture standing before the main finite verb — so 'but' is a helper on παραγγέλλει, as rule 88's own ταρταρώσας παρέδωκεν precedent has it.

Marking 'but' added under rule 86 was considered and rejected: rule 86's test is whether a source token licenses the word, and rule 88 names a participle standing in the same clause as exactly such a token. The competing reading is recorded in the verb's note.
μέν remains unrepresented under rule 70; the correlation it marks is not a word the ASV wrote for the particle.
